reason: I buy index funds monthly in a broker app that charges me nothing, so I don't see why I'd pay a monthly subscription for a cute pet to do roughly the same thing. I'd play with the free demo out of curiosity, but I won't sign up for a paid plan with no price on it.
objection: It's a new app that wants to move my real money and sit between me and my broker, and I have no idea who's behind it or how safe my data and account would be. On top of that it's another subscription, and fees eat returns.
would_change_my_mind: A very low price, a few dollars a month, that's clearly cheaper than a robo-advisor fee, plus a well-known licensed broker actually holding the money and a plain statement of what data they keep.
